title: On-the-ground expense triage and receipt handoff
body:
Purpose: quick reference for staff on-site to triage expenses, capture receipts, and hand off reimbursements with minimal admin friction. Use this as the pocket playbook for booth staff, crew leads, and the vendor liaison.

Primary goals:
- Prevent lost receipts (capture, photo, and upload within 24 hours).
- Standardize naming and categories so Finance can reconcile in bulk.
- Keep petty cash float accounted for; close float each evening.

Quick workflow (one-liner): take photo -> label -> upload to FastReceipts -> log in daily roster -> hand physical receipts to local lead.

Scanning and upload rules:
- Always photograph receipts on a neutral background (table or white paper). Avoid glare.
- Use FastReceipts app (see vendor below). Upload to folder: /events/2025/roadshow-santiago/receipts.
- File naming convention: YYYYMMDD_vendor_amount_last4card (e.g., 20251107_citycafe_42.50_1234).
- Category tags: travel, meals, supplies, shipping, booth-rental, contractor, incidentals. If unsure, tag "unsure" and add a 1-sentence note.

Per-diem & limits (applies to staff without pre-approved corporate card):
- Local per-diem (Santiago): CLP 25,000/day (~USD 30) for meals. Any single meal > USD 75 requires manager note.
- Taxi rides: <= USD 60 OK without preapproval; rides > USD 60 -> get screenshot of route and explain.

Petty cash float (on-site cashier: Zoe W.)
- Float amount: USD 500 in envelope labeled "Roadshow Float 11/2025". Signed log book required for every withdrawal.
- Reconciliation: count at 20:00 daily, photograph cash + log, upload to receipts folder. Any variance > USD 10, notify Maya immediately.

Vendor contacts (local quick dials):
- LocalPrintCo (badge printing, last-minute posters): +56 2 5555 1212 / prints@s-localprint.co / contact: Carla Rojas (fast pickup).
- FastReceipts (receipt scanning/upload support): +1 415 555 9003 / ops@fastreceipts.example / support portal: https://fastreceipts.example/support
- CityCourier (same-day courier for equipment): +56 9 7777 3333 / dispatch@citycourier.cl / note: ask for "corporate event rate".
- PowerRentals (power strips, backup UPS): rentals@powerrenalsexample.com / +1 206 555 0192 / acct: redwood-events

Card usage & blocked categories:
- Company cards should be used when available for contractors, large rentals, and booth deposits. Personal cards okay for meals/taxis but must upload receipts and claim within 7 days.
- Do NOT use company card for alcohol unless pre-approved and itemized with attendee list.

Expense codes (finance mapping quick keys):
- EXP-TRVL-2025 (transportation)
- EXP-MEAL-2025 (meals)
- EXP-SUPPLY-2025 (consumables)
- EXP-RENT-2025 (booth/equipment rental)
- EXP-CTR-2025 (contractor fees)
If you have an internal PO or invoice number, put it in the upload note field.

Receipt triage checklist (first 48 hours):
1) Photo uploaded to FastReceipts + named correctly.
2) Category tag assigned.
3) Payment method noted (card last4 or cash).
4) Business purpose written in one line (e.g., "team dinner, 6 pax, pre-event briefing").
5) If physical receipt needed for vendor invoice: place in envelope and drop to local lead by EOD.

Handoff to finance (how we deliver):
- Daily digest: Zoe compiles the day's uploads into a single zip and posts to Confluence folder /events/2025/roadshow-santiago/finance-ready by 10:00 next morning. Include a short reconciliation CSV (date, filename, amount, category, last4, staff).
- For reimbursements: staff file expense claim in HubExpense (link in linked_artifacts) and attach uploaded receipt URL. Claims must be submitted within 7 days of event end.

Common edge cases + quick fixes:
- Lost receipt: get a signed Lost Receipt Affidavit from staff (template in Confluence) and attach merchant contact info if possible.
- Vendor only gave invoice number: request PDF invoice or photo of invoice header + payment stub. Save under receipts folder as invoice_NUMBER_vendor.pdf.
- Foreign currency: take photo of card transaction or credit slip. Finance will convert using event-day FX rate. Note currency in upload note.

People & roles on-site (who does what):
- Event lead (Maya) — oversees approvals, large charges, escalations.
- On-site cashier (Zoe) — day-to-day float, daily reconciliation, courier coordination.
- Receipts wrangler (Ethan) — ensures upload naming convention and fast-checks categories each evening.

Open items / TODOs before launch:
- Confirm FastReceipts enterprise folder permissions for contractors (TODO: Maya -> ops@fastreceipts, due 2025-11-05).
- Local courier promo code from CityCourier (Ethan to confirm rates, due 2025-11-06).
- Print vendor backup (confirm LocalPrintCo can open at 06:00 on install day).

Notes to self (quick):
- If a vendor pushes a QR payment link, capture merchant name and save screenshot. QR charges sometimes miss merchant detail in bank feeds.
- Keep one spare company card in sealed envelope with lead; only use with two-signature log.

End: keep this doc on phone (offline copy), and update field notes nightly so Finance doesn't have to chase.

Recent edits log:
- 2025-11-02: initial draft (Maya)
- 2025-11-08: added vendor quick dials and petty cash rules (Zoe)
- 2025-11-10: clarified file naming convention and open TODOs (Ethan)

--
If you have immediate questions on reimbursements while on-site ping slack #events-prod-team and prefix with [EXP-URGENT].
